units.source_text: 却说伊豫介于十月初离京赴任地。

en.t: Now Iyo no Suke left the capital at the beginning of the tenth month to take up his post.

units.source_text: 此次是带家眷去的，所以源氏公子的饯别异常隆重。

en.t: This time he was taking his family with him, so Lord Genji's farewell gifts were exceptionally lavish.

units.source_text: 暗中为空蝉置备特别体己的赠品：

en.t: In secret, he prepared especially intimate gifts for Utsusemi:

units.source_text: 精致可爱的梳子和扇子不计其数，连烧给守路神的纸币也特别置备。

en.t: There were countless delicate, charming combs and fans, and he even specially prepared paper offerings to burn for the guardian deities of the road.

units.source_text: 又把那件单衫归还了她，并附有诗句：

en.t: He also returned that unlined robe to her, with a poem attached:
